backlog.spec: Inside fit_predict, run a 5-fold StratifiedKFold(seed) on the training set to get out-of-fold RF and MLP probabilities (use 3 MLP seeds for speed), fit LogisticRegression on logit of these two columns, then fit full RF/MLP and apply the meta-learner to test predictions instead of fixed 0.5/0.5 rank averaging. backlog.spec: Slot 18 (ExtraTrees 1000 trees, max_features 0.5, replacing RF in the RF+MLP blend) gave 0.0890, the best so far but marked reject. backlog.spec: In the MLP part of the blend, train MLPClassifier on duplicated data with sample weights instead of hard labels. This regularizes the MLP's overconfident outputs.
backlog.title: Soft-label MLP via label smoothing

backlog.spec: Compute the Murcko scaffold of each training molecule. Weight each sample by 1/sqrt(size of its scaffold group), normalized to mean 1. Pass the weights as sample_weight to the RF. The MLP is unchanged because sklearn's MLPClassifier has no sample_weight. This down-weights over-represented chemical series so the model generalizes better to unseen scaffolds.
backlog.title: Scaffold-cluster sample weights

backlog.spec: Keep the RF+MLP rank blend and add a 15-NN Jaccard (Tanimoto) kNN on 2048-bit Morgan radius-2 bit vectors as a third equally weighted rank-normalized member (same as slot 46, which scored 0.0874). Prediction is the mean label of the 15 nearest training neighbours weighted by Tanimoto similarity. Use the same code to replicate and confirm the gain.
backlog.title: Replicate kNN Jaccard third member

backlog.spec: On top of the RF+MLP+Morgan-kNN blend, change the kNN to k=25 with weights equal to similarity cubed, computed with a dense Tanimoto matrix via matrix products on Morgan bits (radius 2, 2048). Keep equal rank blend of three members.
backlog.title: kNN k tuning with similarity weighting

backlog.spec: Add a fourth blend member: kNN (k=15) using min-max (generalized Tanimoto) similarity on radius-2 Morgan count fingerprints folded to 2048. Compute similarity as sum(min)/sum(max) with numpy chunking. Rank-average all four members equally.
backlog.title: Second kNN on count Morgan (min-max)

backlog.spec: Add a kNN member (k=15, Tanimoto similarity) on 2048-bit atom-pair fingerprint bits as an additional blend member alongside RF, MLP and the Morgan kNN, rank-averaged equally. Diversifies the similarity view.
backlog.title: Atom-pair kNN member

backlog.spec: Train each of the 5 MLPs on a bootstrap resample of training rows (seeded with seed+i, using rows stratified by class), keeping the quantile-normal features and the rest of the settings. Average probabilities as before. Increases ensemble diversity.
backlog.title: Bootstrap-bagged MLPs

backlog.spec: Replace MLPClassifier with MLPRegressor (same architecture, early_stopping) trained on smoothed targets 0.05 for class 0 and 0.95 for class 1, using the 5-seed ensemble; use the regression outputs as the MLP scores in the rank blend.
backlog.title: Soft-label MLP via label smoothing

backlog.spec: After the initial blend, take the test molecules whose blend rank score is in the top 20% or bottom 20% (confident), add them with predicted labels to the training set, and refit the MLP ensemble and RF once; output the final blend on all test molecules. Uses only test SMILES, no labels.
backlog.title: Pseudo-label self-training

backlog.spec: Configure MLPClassifier with solver adam, learning_rate_init 3e-4, batch_size 64, alpha 3e-2, n_iter_no_change 15, max_iter 300, keeping early stopping. Keep 5 seeds and the RF+MLP rank blend.
backlog.title: Adam MLP with decayed learning rate

backlog.spec: In knn_predict, change k from 25 to 40 and the similarity exponent from 3 to 2 (keep Morgan radius-2 2048-bit Tanimoto). Leave the rest of the blend unchanged. One edit to the default k and the power in the weights line.
backlog.title: Tune kNN k and similarity power

backlog.spec: Add a fourth rank-blend member: a Tanimoto kNN identical to knn_predict (k=25, similarity cubed) but on 2048-bit atom-pair fingerprint bits from rdFingerprintGenerator.GetAtomPairGenerator(fpSize=2048). Give the Morgan kNN and the atom-pair kNN each weight 0.5 inside a combined kNN rank, which then counts as one third of the blend. Generalize knn_predict to accept a fingerprint function.
backlog.title: Second kNN on atom-pair bits, k=25 cubed

backlog.spec: Change the final blend to weights 0.25 RF, 0.35 MLP, 0.40 kNN on the rank-normalized predictions, instead of equal thirds. No other changes.
backlog.title: Weighted blend favoring kNN

backlog.spec: Switch the kNN fingerprint to Morgan radius 3 with 4096 bits (a new morgan_bits parameter used only by knn_predict) and keep k=25 with similarity cubed. This tests whether a more specific neighbourhood helps.
backlog.title: Radius-3 Morgan kNN with chirality-free bits

backlog.spec: In knn_predict, compute each neighbour's similarity as usual, but in the weights multiply by a factor of 0.7 for neighbours with similarity above 0.8. This reduces the effect of near-duplicate analogs and shrinks overconfident predictions. Keep the other settings as they are.
backlog.title: kNN with scaffold-aware neighbor exclusion

backlog.spec: After the first blend, take the 25% most confident test molecules (by blend rank extremes) and add them to the training set with hard labels (top 12.5% as 1, bottom 12.5% as 0). Refit only the MLP ensemble on train plus pseudo-labelled data and recompute the blend with the new MLP predictions. Seeds are deterministic.
backlog.title: Pseudo-label self-training of the MLP

backlog.spec: Before quantile-transforming for the MLP only, drop columns whose absolute Pearson correlation with an earlier kept column exceeds 0.95, and drop constant columns. Compute the filter on the training fold only and apply it to the test fold. The RF keeps all features.
backlog.title: Correlation filter on descriptors for the MLP

backlog.spec: Add a fourth blend member: kernel ridge regression (sklearn KernelRidge, kernel='precomputed', alpha=1.0) on the Morgan-bit Tanimoto similarity matrix with the target mapped to ±1. Compute the train-train and test-train Tanimoto matrices with the same dense matrix-product trick used in knn_predict. Rank-normalize its output and give it equal weight with the others.
backlog.title: Rank-average SVC on Tanimoto kernel replaced by kNN-kernel ridge

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, replace the equal-weight rank average of p_rf, p_mlp, p_knn with weights 0.25 RF, 0.35 MLP, 0.40 kNN (fixed constants, no inner CV). Keep the denominators normalized so output is in [0,1].
backlog.title: Blend weights tilted toward kNN

backlog.spec: In morgan_bits use radius=3 with fpSize=2048 (bits, not counts) for the kNN member only, keeping k=25 and the cubed similarity weights. Leave all other features unchanged.
backlog.title: Radius-3 Morgan bit kNN replaces radius-2

backlog.spec: Replace the 5 MLPClassifiers with 5 MLPRegressors (same layers (256,64), alpha 1e-2, early_stopping, different seeds) trained on smoothed targets 0.05 for class 0 and 0.95 for class 1. Use the regressor output as p_mlp, then rank it as before. Keep batch_size default so runtime stays low.
backlog.title: Label-smoothed MLP via regression

backlog.spec: Train each of the 5 MLPs on a bootstrap resample of the training rows drawn with np.random.RandomState(seed+i), instead of the full set. Keep the rest of the MLP config unchanged. Average the probabilities as before.
backlog.title: Bootstrap-bagged MLPs

backlog.spec: After computing the initial 3-member rank blend, take the test molecules whose blend score is above 0.85 (label 1) or below 0.15 (label 0). Add them to the MLP training matrix with those hard labels. Retrain the 5 MLPs on the augmented set and use the new p_mlp in the final blend. Leave RF and kNN as they are.
backlog.title: Pseudo-label self-training for MLP

backlog.spec: After featurizing, compute the correlation matrix of the descriptor columns on the training set only. Drop one of each pair with absolute correlation above 0.95 and drop constant columns. Apply the same kept-column mask to the test set. Use the filtered matrix for the MLP branch and quantile transform only. Leave the RF on the full matrix.
backlog.title: Correlation filter on descriptors

backlog.spec: Change knn_predict to a similarity-weighted vote that also mixes in a prior. Use k=25, weights sim**3, and add 0.5 pseudo-neighbors at the training base rate: p=(sum(w*y)+0.5*w.mean()*prior)/(sum(w)+0.5*w.mean()). This smooths predictions for molecules with low-similarity neighbors.
backlog.title: Larger kNN with distance-rank weighting on both Morgan and kNN agreement

backlog.spec: Make knn_predict accept a radius argument and compute it for radii 1, 2 and 3 on 2048-bit Morgan bits (k=25, cubed similarity). Average the three kNN outputs by rank into one p_knn member. The blend remains three members with equal weights.
backlog.title: Multi-radius Morgan kNN ensemble

backlog.spec: Since MLPClassifier has no sample_weight, emulate it. Compute Murcko scaffold counts in the training set. For each of the 5 MLPs, draw a resample of the training rows with probability proportional to 1/sqrt(scaffold count), with the same size as the training set, seeded by seed+i. Train on that resample. This tests whether the MLP generalizes better to unseen scaffolds.
backlog.title: Sample weights up-weighting scaffold-rare molecules in the MLP

backlog.spec: Add a fourth rank-blend member. Fit sklearn LogisticRegression (C=0.05, liblinear, L2) on log1p Morgan count fingerprints (radius 2, 2048 bits). Use predict_proba as the member. Then rank-average the four members with weights 1/4 each.
backlog.title: SGD-based linear SVM on Morgan counts as blend member

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, change the final rank blend from equal weights to (rankdata(p_rf) + rankdata(p_mlp) + 2*rankdata(p_knn)) / (4*n). Nothing else changes. The kNN is the strongest recent addition, so give it more weight.
backlog.title: Tilt blend toward kNN (weights 1:1:2)

backlog.spec: After computing the first blend, take the 15% most confident test molecules by blended rank (top and bottom 7.5%). Add them to the MLP training set with hard labels (top=1, bottom=0). Refit the 5 MLPs on the augmented quantile-transformed matrix and recompute p_mlp. Then re-blend with the unchanged RF and kNN predictions. Use the seed for all randomness.
backlog.title: Pseudo-label self-training for MLP

backlog.spec: Replace the 5 identical-data MLPs with 8 MLPs. Each is trained on a bootstrap resample of the training rows, drawn with np.random.RandomState(seed+i). Keep the hidden sizes, alpha and early stopping unchanged, and average predict_proba. This adds diversity through the data rather than the architecture.
backlog.title: Bootstrap-bagged MLPs

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, after featurize, compute the absolute correlation matrix of the first len(Descriptors.descList) columns on the training set only. Greedily drop columns with |r|>0.95 to an earlier-kept column, and drop constant columns. Apply the same column mask to the train and test matrices, keeping the pharmacophore bits. Feed the filtered matrix to the RF and the MLP.
backlog.title: Correlation filter for descriptors

backlog.spec: Compute Murcko scaffold counts on the training molecules. Pass sample_weight to the RF fit as 1/sqrt(count) normalized to mean 1. The MLPs and kNN stay unchanged. Slot 35 tried a similar scaffold-size weighting, so use a sharper power of 1 with clipping to [0.2, 3].
backlog.title: Up-weight scaffold-rare molecules in the RF

backlog.spec: Change the Morgan kNN so that, among the top 50 neighbors, each Murcko scaffold contributes at most its 2 most similar molecules. Then use the 25 best remaining neighbors with similarity-cubed weights. This reduces the dominance of large congeneric series and mimics the scaffold split.
backlog.title: kNN with scaffold-diverse neighbor voting

backlog.spec: Give morgan_bits a radius parameter. Use radius 3 with 2048 bits in knn_predict, keeping k=25 and the cubed similarity weights. The other blend members are unchanged.
backlog.title: Radius-3 Morgan kNN replaces radius-2

backlog.spec: Before fitting the RF and MLPs (not the kNN), run a 5-fold inner cross-validation with a quick RF (100 trees). Remove training molecules whose out-of-fold probability for their own label is below 0.1. Fit the RF and MLP on the cleaned set only.
backlog.title: Label-noise-robust training: drop suspicious labels

backlog.spec: Set the MLPs to solver='adam', hidden_layer_sizes=(512,), alpha=0.05, learning_rate_init=1e-3, batch_size=128, max_iter=30, early_stopping=False. Average 8 seeds. The short fixed schedule replaces validation-based early stopping, which is noisy on small folds.
backlog.title: MLP with SELU-like wider net and Adam, tuned epochs

backlog.spec: Fit the QuantileTransformer on np.vstack([Xtr, Xte]). Only unlabeled features are used, so this is transductive and leaks no labels. Use the result for the MLP inputs. The aim is to reduce distribution shift on unseen scaffolds. Nothing else changes.
backlog.title: Quantile-transform fit on train plus test features

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, change the final rank blend so the Morgan Tanimoto kNN prediction gets weight 2 and RF and MLP get weight 1 each: (rankdata(p_rf)+rankdata(p_mlp)+2*rankdata(p_knn))/(4*n). No other changes.
backlog.title: Tilt blend toward kNN (1:1:2)

backlog.spec: Fit the QuantileTransformer on np.vstack([Xtr, Xte]) (unsupervised, transductive), then transform Xtr and Xte separately. This gives better-calibrated feature scaling for the MLP on unseen scaffolds. The labels are not used.
backlog.title: Fit quantile transformer on train plus test features

backlog.spec: Before the QuantileTransformer for the MLP branch, compute the absolute Pearson correlation matrix of the training columns. Drop columns with |r|>0.95 to an earlier column, and drop constant columns. Keep the RF on the full features. Apply the same column mask to the test features.
backlog.title: Drop highly correlated descriptors for the MLP

backlog.spec: In knn_predict, compute the Murcko scaffold of each training molecule. Among the top 40 neighbors by similarity, keep at most 2 per scaffold (the most similar ones). Then use the cubed-similarity weighted vote over the kept neighbors, up to 25. This reduces over-counting of near-duplicate series.
backlog.title: Scaffold-diverse kNN voting

backlog.spec: For the MLP training labels, replace y with 0.8*y + 0.2*(leave-one-out Morgan Tanimoto kNN prediction on the training set, k=10, self excluded). Since MLPClassifier needs hard labels, use sample_weight-free duplication: stack the training rows twice, once with label 1 and once with label 0, using integer repeat counts proportional to the soft probability (round p*4 copies of label 1 and 4-round(p*4) copies of label 0). Keep the rest of the pipeline.
backlog.title: Soft-label MLP via kNN-smoothed targets

backlog.spec: Make the Morgan kNN an average of 10 runs. Each run uses a random 70% subset of the 2048 bit columns (RandomState(seed+i)). Use k=25 and cubed similarity. Rank-average them into one kNN member for the blend.
backlog.title: Bootstrap-bagged kNN with feature-bit subsampling

backlog.spec: Before fitting, run a leave-one-out Morgan kNN (k=10) on the training set. Drop training molecules where the kNN predicted probability of the true class is below 0.1 and the max neighbor similarity is above 0.6, which suggests a label conflict with a near-duplicate. Use the cleaned set for RF and MLP only. Keep the kNN on the full data.
backlog.title: Label-noise filtering

backlog.spec: Add a fourth rank-blend member: an RBF-kernel KernelRidge or SVC(probability=False) on the quantile-normal descriptors, restricted to the descriptor columns with the hidden pharmacophore bits excluded. Use gamma=1/(n_features*4) and C=1, and take decision_function as the score. Weight it equally with the other members.
backlog.title: Gaussian process-like kernel ridge on descriptors

backlog.spec: Replace the 5 MLPClassifiers with MLPs trained using solver='adam', early_stopping=False, max_iter=30, and warm_start. After each of epochs 20 to 30, take predict_proba on the test set and average the snapshots, then average over 5 seeds. This approximates a snapshot ensemble that reduces variance. Keep alpha=1e-2.
backlog.title: Cosine-decayed MLP with snapshot averaging

incumbent.description: Add a 25-NN Morgan-bit Tanimoto kNN with similarity-cubed weights (dense matrix products) as a third equal rank-blend member alongside RF and MLP.

memo:
Helped: only big structural moves. Morgan+RF at 0.1361 became quantile-transformed descriptors with an SVC (0.1282). The Gobbi pharmacophore fingerprint gave 0.1072. The RF+MLP rank blend gave 0.0926. A 25-NN Morgan-bit Tanimoto kNN with cubed similarity as a third member gave 0.0852/0.0765, the incumbent (mean_adjusted 0.0809).
Didn't help: more tree or boosting models (XGBoost 0.0923, LightGBM 0.0903, CatBoost 0.0907), MACCS 0.0914, FCFP 0.0967, stacking 0.0966, MLP variants (PCA 0.0976, varied MLPs 0.0945, and others at 0.0838-0.0855). kNN retunes (k=40 with exponent 2: 0.0870; linear weights: 0.0876) and a second atom-pair kNN (0.0851) didn't beat it. Runtime over 10 minutes caused the crashes. Many slots were wasted on repeat ideas.
Next: check history before proposing. Try tilting the blend weights toward the kNN. Add a different kind of diverse member, not a tree, boosting or MLP variant. Keep runtime low.
